proof_summary: Assuming the asserted additive formula, the shifted terms \(a_n+1\) follow a Fibonacci matrix orbit; modulo \(195318521017\), exponentiation through \(249580073233\) steps shows that both \(a_{249580077007}\) and \(a_{249580077006}\) are divisible by this modulus. Their gcd is therefore greater than \(1\), so the defining gcd recurrence at the next index cannot equal \(1+a_{n-1}+a_{n-2}\), giving a contradiction.
